thoughts:
My decision on 2026-09-03: HOLD SPY (conviction: medium).

Pure hold-discipline day. SPY closed 769.62 today (9/03), vs 761.78 on 9/01 and 771.10 on 8/27 — a tight 762-771 range for two weeks, holding comfortably above the 8/03 breakout bar (757.67) and my 755.00 trigger. None of my three pre-committed exit conditions fired, so the thesis stands unchanged and no trade is warranted. Watcher remains 'caution' (higher-yield pressure, Mideast oil, gold-repatriation noise) — none of which is SEVERE and none of which is new information versus last week. I am deliberately NOT chasing the momentum leaders: ETH +30.2% and BTC +23.1% over 30 days, GLD +10.3% — buying a leader after the move on no dated catalyst is exactly the beta-mistaken-for-skill trade this project already paid to learn. My equity ($1,024.76) trails SPY ($1,030.64) by ~$6, essentially my accumulated API cost, which reinforces that the correct action is fewer decisions, not more.

What would prove me wrong: Unchanged: (1) a single SPY close below 755.00 (under the 8/03 757.67 breakout bar) on or before 2026-10-15 -> breakout failed, sell to CASH; (2) two consecutive closes below 728.00 (6/26 728.99 / 7/29 729.46 shelf) before 2026-10-15 -> CASH; (3) Watcher SEVERE -> immediate exit to CASH ('caution' or a stale read does not qualify). Absent one of these observable events, I hold and place no new trades.

strategy.rule: One decision per US trading day by claude-opus-5 over prices, headlines, and the Watcher; guardrails in code: long only, 1 position, 1 trade/day, SEVERE=cash, $750 floor; its own API bill is charged to the account
strategy.backtest_cagr: NO BACKTEST POSSIBLE — sentiment/reasoning has no historical replay; the live run IS the test
strategy.backtest_maxdd: External evidence: LLM agents show no credible net-of-cost alpha (LiveTradeBench). Expectation: ~zero. API cost so far $1.62
strategy.note: Glass-box experiment: every decision logs verbatim reasoning plus a falsifier the attribution log scores later. Judged by kill_criteria.md like every other bot.
